title: OpenClaw on AWS

venue.name: VVCE
venue.address: P.B. No.206, Kannada Sahithya Parishath Rd, III Stage, Gokulam, Mysuru, Karnataka 570017

speakers.name: Yeshwanth L M
speakers.title: Solutions Engineer, AWS Community Builder, Lead of AWS UG Mysuru

description: A hands-on deep dive into deploying OpenClaw on AWS: evaluating architectural paths by scale, budget and operational overhead, from rapid development on Amazon Lightsail to custom enterprise control on Amazon EC2, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and Amazon EKS, followed by a hands-on Lightsail workshop.
